title: Plugs and Sockets Quality Control Order 2022
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
penaltyProvisions: Under Section 17 of the BIS Act 2016 — imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine up to ₹2 lakhs for first offence.
applicability: All domestic and industrial plugs, socket-outlets, and adaptors sold, imported, or manufactured in India.
testingRequirements: Mandatory third-party testing at BIS-recognized / NABL-accredited laboratories.
description: This order mandates that all plugs and socket-outlets for domestic use shall conform to IS 1293:2019 and shall bear the ISI mark.
summary: Mandates IS 1293:2019 compliance for all domestic plugs and socket-outlets — ISI mark compulsory.

title: Toys (Quality Control) Order 2020
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
penaltyProvisions: Under BIS Act 2016 — up to 2 years imprisonment and/or fine for non-compliance.
applicability: All toys for children up to 14 years manufactured, imported, or sold in India.
exemptions: Toys for collector use (not for children)
testingRequirements: BIS-recognized laboratory testing mandatory. ISI mark on every toy unit.
description: Mandates all toys for children comply with BIS Indian Standards for mechanical, flammability, and chemical safety.
summary: ISI mark compulsory on all toys sold in India — covers mechanical, chemical, and flammability safety.

title: Batteries and Accessories — Compulsory Registration Order Phase V
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
penaltyProvisions: Under IT Act provisions — import prohibition without CRS registration, penalty up to ₹5 lakhs per consignment.
applicability: Lithium-ion secondary cells and batteries for portable applications imported or sold in India.
exemptions: Batteries used in approved medical devices
Batteries in sealed OEM assemblies with existing CRS
testingRequirements: Testing at BIS-empanelled laboratories. CRS R-Number mandatory before import or sale.
description: Phase V of MeitY's Compulsory Registration Order adds lithium-ion cells and batteries to the mandatory CRS list.
summary: CRS R-Number mandatory for all lithium-ion batteries — tested to IS 16046 (Part 2):2018.

title: Solar Photovoltaic Modules Quality Control Order 2022
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
penaltyProvisions: Under BIS Act 2016 — mandatory BIS certification for all solar PV modules used in government and grid-connected projects.
applicability: Crystalline silicon solar PV modules manufactured, imported, or used in grid-connected solar projects in India.
testingRequirements: BIS certification mandatory. Testing at NABL-accredited PV testing labs.
description: Mandates BIS certification for solar PV modules used in grid-connected and government-funded installations in India.
summary: BIS certification compulsory for solar PV modules — part of ALMM (Approved List of Models & Manufacturers).

title: Packaged Drinking Water Quality Control Order 2019
ministry: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) / Ministry of Health
penaltyProvisions: Under FSS Act 2006 and BIS Act 2016 — cancellation of licence, product recall, and fines.
applicability: All packaged drinking water sold in India — 200ml sachets to 20-litre jars.
exemptions: Natural mineral water (covered by separate regulation)
testingRequirements: ISI mark mandatory. Third-party NABL-accredited lab testing required quarterly.
description: Mandates BIS ISI mark on all packaged drinking water ensuring compliance with IS 14543:2016 quality and safety parameters.
summary: ISI mark compulsory on all packaged drinking water — covers physical, chemical, and microbiological parameters.
